name: __js_throw

ownership.argument: Settled while looking for the exception accessors; it is the writer that pairs with qjs_get_exception, and it explains why the exception slot is the invariant for both.

provenance.source: Writes the new exception into the runtime slot at rt+128 (freeing the previous one first) and returns JS_EXCEPTION (0x600000000).
